components.css: .ds-switch{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:17px 34px 17px 22px;background:linear-gradient(#0d2f42,#0c222f);border:1px solid #163f54;border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45);text-decoration:none;transition:box-shadow .18s ease,border-color .18s ease}.ds-switch-lamp{position:relative;display:block;width:26px;height:46px;border-radius:4px;background:#0a0d0e;border:1px solid #2d3538}.ds-switch-lamp::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:3px 3px auto 3px;height:20px;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(#931432,#8f1330);transition:box-shadow .2s ease}.ds-switch-label{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#eae1d7}.ds-switch:hover{border-color:#835a49;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 0 34px rgba(147,20,50,.3)}.ds-switch:hover .ds-switch-lamp::after{box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(227,135,124,.85)}.ds-switch:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #bd8c68;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: The landing page is the classroom overhead projector the product belongs to: a charcoal machine holding a lit acetate sheet. The sheet carries the page's content and the product's one claim in the same gesture — Markdown on the left, what it becomes on the right, one grease pencil, one switch. The room is dark because that is what makes the sheet read as light.\n\nColour comes from Ensigns, family Pequod: its dark roles build the room and the machine, its light roles the plate and the stock, and ahab is the only accent. The world is not a costume: no drawn projector arm, no stock illustration, no browser mockup.
keyCharacteristics: One lit field carries the page; everything else recedes into the room.
The product demonstrates itself: source and result are the same sheet, paired line by line.
One accent, used as a tool: a grease pencil for the lamp, the paired line, and one hand-written note.
Materials are paper, acetate, steel and light.
Type does the talking: the app's own serif, mono and condensed labels, plus a single hand.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: Only one surface in a viewport is lit. A second pale field is paper and must read as stock on a desk, not as another screen.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Red is state and action, never decoration. If a red element does not mean 'press this' or 'this line is paired', it is wrong.

rules.name: The Source Is Set As Source Rule
rules.body: Markdown stays monospace and keeps its markers; the markers are the only coloured glyphs.

rules.name: The Ensigns Rule
rules.body: A colour that is not a role of Ensigns Pequod does not appear on this page; the ten family cards are the exception, since each demonstrates its own family.

dos: Do take every colour from Ensigns Pequod, as a role rather than a hex of your own.
Do keep the pairing interaction as the page's only authored motion.
Do let the product's own text be the hero.
Do keep red for action and state only.
Do keep every demonstrated detail true to the product.
donts: Don't introduce a colour Ensigns does not define.
Don't draw the projector as an illustration, add a browser mockup, or reach for nautical props.
Don't use cream-plus-serif as the ground, gradient text, glass panels, generated grain, or an eyebrow above a heading.
Don't let paper become a second screen.
Don't add a second accent or a second hand-written voice.
